purpose: Instance-level pre-declarations found by the two clean-context inventory reviews (review_1.md, review_2.md) while probing the record. Committed here so they are timestamped before either arm runs, but NOT part of the inventory either arm sees: the translators never see the inventory, and the baseline reviewer receives only inventory.md. At results time this file becomes a scorecard: for each instance, did the ledger arm surface it unprompted, did the baseline, did neither. The inventory keeps only the general dimensions these instances motivated.
found_by: frontier adversarial review (Opus) armed with the claim inventory — itself a data point against the five prior unstructured README reviews, which surfaced none of these.
